platform_name: noble-post-quantum: Auditable & minimal JS implementation of public-key post-quantum cryptography
product_brief: Auditable & minimal JS implementation of public-key post-quantum cryptography.
pqc_capability_description: Implements ML-KEM (Kyber), ML-DSA (Dilithium), SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+), and Falcon Round 3. Includes hybrid algorithms combining PQC with classic ECC (X25519, P-256, P-384). Based on FIPS-203, FIPS-204, and FIPS-205 standards.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, Falcon, X25519, P-256, P-384, SHA2, SHA3, SHAKE, HKDF-SHA256
key_management_model: Software-based key generation and encapsulation/signing within the JS runtime; no external HSM or MPC mentioned.
fips_validated: No (Implements algorithms defined in FIPS-203, FIPS-204, FIPS-205, but library itself is not stated as FIPS validated)
primary_platforms: Node.js, Deno, Browsers, React Native (with polyfill)
implementation_attack_surface: No protection against side-channel attacks; vulnerable to timing attacks.
testing_&_validation_methods: Passes published Round 3 KATs for Falcon; includes internal tests for correctness.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Minimal dependencies (noble-hashes, noble-curves); PGP-signed commits; transparent NPM builds; pinned dependencies.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Tree-shakeable; supports hybrid algorithms for gradual migration; old Kyber version not provided (incompatible).

platform_name: ML-DSA-OSH: open-source hardware implementation of ML-DSA (KU Leuven-COSIC)
product_brief: Open-source hardware implementation of ML-DSA by KU Leuven-COSIC.

platform_name: Preparing for The Quantum Era: AT&T Business Debuts Post-Quantum Cryptography Secure SD-WAN, Powered by Cisco
product_brief: Quantum Resilient SD-WAN service delivering post-quantum cryptography powered by Cisco 8000 Series Secure Router.

Provides comprehensive quantum-resilient solutions including encryption, authentication, and secure boot capabilities with standards-based implementation.
architecture_type: Converged networking and security architecture; SASE-enabled architecture
regulatory_status: Aligns to NIST standards; meets industry compliance
pqc_roadmap_details: Service will be available later this year (2026) to AT&T Business customers globally.
authoritative_source_url: Managed SASE Cybersecurity Network Solution | AT&T Business

product_brief: Secure mobile chip with NFC, secure element, eSIM, and PQC hardware accelerator for mobile devices.
pqc_capability_description: Features a hardware accelerator for post-quantum cryptography supporting ML-KEM and ML-DSA algorithms. Designed to support transition from hybrid cryptographic approaches toward full post-quantum deployment. Sampling available now; production targeted for July 2026.
target_industries: Mobile network operators, banks, governments, transit operators, car manufacturers, digital-wallet and service providers
pqc_roadmap_details: Sampling available now; production and certification targeted for July 2026. Supports transition from hybrid cryptographic approaches toward full post-quantum deployment.
implementation_attack_surface: Designed to help protect against side-channel and fault-injection attacks.
testing_&_validation_methods: Completed certification testing under Common Criteria 2022 EUCC and EMVCo.
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Designed for mobile devices and personal electronics; single-die solution with NFC, secure element, and eSIM.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Supports transition from hybrid cryptographic approaches toward full post-quantum deployment.
